title: Datadog US1 - January Scheduled Maintenance Window
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: January Scheduled Maintenance Window
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2017-01-06T21:00:00.000-05:00
Scheduled until: 2017-01-06T23:00:00.000-05:00
Updates:
- 2017-01-06T22:41:38.054-05:00: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2017-01-06T21:00:30.343-05:00: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2017-01-03T12:18:58.733-05:00: scheduled - We will be performing proactive maintenance for a window of no longer than 2 hours this Friday. 
The window will start at 2017-01-06 21:00 EST (2017-01-06 01:00 UTC). 
During this period, you may come across our 'down' page, but that is to be expected. There may be a brief period during this maintenance window when alerts may not be sent. In this event, we will keep our Status Page updated here. 
*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed. 
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com
